classes.name: GradientStop
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Colour stop of Brush::linear_gradient(); a plain value pair.

classes.name: Pen
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Outline value type set on Canvas; shown in the ex_scene snippet.

classes.name: SystemFontInfo
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Plain record of an installed face returned by SystemFonts, whose example shows it.

classes.name: Theme
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Plain style values (colours, sizes, spacing) handed to FormView, whose example shows them in use.

classes.name: SettingChoice
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of one option of a Choice field of a SettingsForm.

classes.name: SettingField
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type describing one field of a SettingsForm.

classes.name: BrainFrameBuilder
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Describes brain view frames for any GPU backend; exercised with a golden image by test_viz_brain_view and against the 3-D shaders of mne_viz_qt by test_viz_qt_brain_window.

classes.name: BrainInstanceUniforms
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Plain uniform-block value type of the instanced glyph shaders, written by the brain view per draw.

classes.name: BrainInstancedStreams
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of an instanced glyph mesh's streams passed to BrainFrameBuilder::draw_instanced().

classes.name: BrainSliceUniforms
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Plain uniform-block value type of the MRI slice shader, written by the brain view per draw.

classes.name: BrainSurfaceStreams
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of a surface's vertex and index streams passed to BrainFrameBuilder::draw_surface().

classes.name: BrainSurfaceUniforms
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Plain uniform-block value type of the surface shaders, written by the brain view per draw.

classes.name: BrainTextureView
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Plain pointer-and-revision pair passed to the textured draws of BrainFrameBuilder.

classes.name: BrainVideoBillboardUniforms
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Plain uniform-block value type of the video disk shader, written by the brain view per draw.

classes.name: BrainVideoDecalUniforms
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Plain uniform-block value type of the video decal shaders, written by the brain view per draw.

classes.name: GpuStreamView
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type pairing mesh bytes with their generation, passed to BrainFrameBuilder.

classes.name: GpuBuffer
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of buffer contents stored in GpuResources.

classes.name: GpuDraw
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of one draw call inside a GpuPass.

classes.name: GpuFrame
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of one frame's passes and draws, built by TraceFrameBuilder and executed by SoftwareRenderer or viz::qt::RhiFrameRenderer.

classes.name: GpuFrameTarget
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of the target size, pixel ratio and clip-space correction a backend hands to a frame producer.

classes.name: GpuPass
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of a render pass inside a GpuFrame.

classes.name: GpuPipeline
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of a pipeline description stored in GpuResources.

classes.name: GpuRect
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of a viewport or scissor rectangle of a GpuDraw.

classes.name: GpuResources
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Store of buffers, textures and pipelines filled by frame producers such as TraceFrameBuilder; exercised by test_viz_gpu_frame.

classes.name: GpuTexture
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of texture contents stored in GpuResources.

classes.name: GpuTextureBinding
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type binding a texture to a sampler of a GpuDraw.

classes.name: GpuUniformBlock
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of the bytes of one uniform block of a GpuDraw.

classes.name: GpuVertexAttribute
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of one vertex attribute of a GpuPipeline.

classes.name: GpuVertexBinding
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of one vertex buffer layout of a GpuPipeline.

classes.name: SoftwareBindings
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Read-only view of a draw's uniform blocks and textures passed to software shaders.

classes.name: SoftwareFragment
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of a fragment's position passed to software shaders.

classes.name: SoftwareRenderer
classes.exempt_reason: registry: CPU backend of the GPU frame description; exercised with golden images by test_viz_gpu_frame and test_viz_trace_view.

classes.name: SoftwareShader
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of a C++ shader registered with SoftwareRenderer.

classes.name: TraceFrameBuilder
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Describes trace view frames for any GPU backend; driven by viz::qt::ChannelRhiRenderer and exercised with a golden image by test_viz_trace_view.

classes.name: TraceOverlayUniforms
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Plain uniform-block value type of the trace overlay shader, written by TraceFrameBuilder.

classes.name: Surface
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Interface a backend implements to host a view; mne::viz::sdl::SdlHost implements it and ex_scene_sdl uses it.

classes.name: SurfaceClient
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Interface of a hosted view; TraceViewClient implements it and ex_scene_sdl shows one in SDL.

classes.name: SurfaceSize
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Size value of Surface; passed by every backend to SurfaceClient::resize().

classes.name: BidsTree
classes.exempt_reason: registry: View model of the BIDS browser; mirrored by viz::qt::BidsViewModel and exercised by test_viz_viewmodels, it has no standalone use without a view.

classes.name: ChannelTable
classes.exempt_reason: registry: View model of the channel information table; adapted by viz::qt::ChannelInfoModel and exercised by test_viz_viewmodels, it has no standalone use without a view.

classes.name: SpectrumTable
classes.exempt_reason: registry: View model of the spectrum viewer; drawn by SpectrumFigure, whose panel example shows it, and exercised by test_viz_viewmodels.

classes.name: ArtifactPanel
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Tool panel of an MNE Scan and MNE Analyze plugin, shown by the backends' panel hosts; works like CompensatorPanel, whose example shows the pattern.

classes.name: AveragingPanel
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Tool panel of an MNE Scan and MNE Analyze plugin, shown by the backends' panel hosts; works like CompensatorPanel, whose example shows the pattern.

classes.name: ConnectivityPanel
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Tool panel of the MNE Scan connectivity plugin and the connectivity examples, which host it; works like CompensatorPanel, whose example shows the pattern.

classes.name: CovariancePanel
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Tool panel of an MNE Scan plugin, shown by the backends' panel hosts; works like CompensatorPanel, whose example shows the pattern.

classes.name: FilterDesignPanel
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Tool panel of the MNE Analyze filtering and MNE Scan noise reduction plugins, shown by the backends' panel hosts; works like CompensatorPanel, whose example shows the pattern.

classes.name: FilterSettingsPanel
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Tool panel of the MNE Analyze filtering and MNE Scan noise reduction plugins, shown by the backends' panel hosts; works like CompensatorPanel, whose example shows the pattern.

classes.name: ForwardPanel
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Tool panel of the MNE Scan forward plugin, shown by the backends' panel hosts; works like CompensatorPanel, whose example shows the pattern.

classes.name: MinimumNormPanel
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Tool panel of an MNE Scan plugin, shown by the backends' panel hosts; works like CompensatorPanel, whose example shows the pattern.

classes.name: ProjectorsPanel
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Tool panel shown by the backends' panel hosts in MNE Scan; works like CompensatorPanel, whose example shows the pattern.

classes.name: SpharaPanel
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Tool panel of an MNE Scan plugin, shown by the backends' panel hosts; works like CompensatorPanel, whose example shows the pattern.

classes.name: TimeFrequencyPanel
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Tool panel of an MNE Scan plugin, shown by the backends' panel hosts; works like CompensatorPanel, whose example shows the pattern.

classes.name: TriggerDetectionPanel
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Tool panel of an MNE Scan and MNE Analyze plugin, shown by the backends' panel hosts; works like CompensatorPanel, whose example shows the pattern.

classes.name: BrainViewInteraction
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Input state machine of the 3-D brain view; driven by viz::qt::BrainViewCore and exercised by test_viz_brain_view, it has no standalone use without a 3-D host.

classes.name: BrainViewOverlay
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Head-up display of the 3-D brain view; painted by viz::qt::BrainViewCore with paintScene() and exercised by test_viz_brain_view with a golden SVG.

classes.name: CameraMatrices
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Result value of OrbitCamera; filled into the QRhi uniforms by viz::qt::BrainViewCore.

classes.name: OrbitCamera
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Projection, view and orbit maths of the 3-D brain view; used by viz::qt::BrainViewCore and viz::qt::CameraController and exercised by test_viz_brain_view.

classes.name: PaneCamera
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Camera state of a pane of the 3-D brain view; viz::qt::SubView derives from it and test_viz_brain_view covers it.

classes.name: KeyEvent
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Toolkit-neutral input value type passed to BrainViewInteraction::handle_key(); hosts convert their native events to it.

classes.name: PointerEvent
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Toolkit-neutral input value type passed to TraceView::handle_pointer(); hosts convert their native events to it.

classes.name: WheelEvent
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Toolkit-neutral input value type passed to TraceView::handle_wheel(); hosts convert their native events to it.

classes.name: PaneLayout
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Pane geometry and splitters of the multi-view 3-D brain view; driven by BrainViewInteraction and wrapped by viz::qt::MultiViewLayout.

classes.name: PixelRect
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Integer rectangle value type of MultiViewLayout and BrainViewOverlay.

classes.name: PixelSize
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Integer size value type of MultiViewLayout and BrainViewOverlay.

classes.name: Ray
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Pick ray of the 3-D brain view built by ray_from_pixel(); used by viz::qt::BrainViewCore and the 3-D renderables of mne_viz_qt' picking.

classes.name: SphereCrossing
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Result value of intersect_ray_sphere(), used for dipole and electrode picking in mne_viz_qt.

classes.name: SweepBuffer
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Sweeping window of the real-time raw-data view; driven by viz::qt::RtFiffRawViewModel and exercised by test_viz_trace_buffer, it has no standalone use without a real-time host.

classes.name: TraceBuffer
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Sample store and channel resolution of the raw-data trace view; wrapped by viz::qt::ChannelDataModel and exercised by test_viz_trace_buffer, it has no standalone use without a trace host.

classes.name: TraceDraw
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type pairing a logical channel with its TraceUniforms; produced by TraceGeometry::draws().

classes.name: TraceGeometry
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Streams trace vertices and per-trace shader parameters for a GPU trace host; driven by viz::qt::ChannelRhiRenderer and exercised by test_viz_trace_view.

classes.name: TraceStyle
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of trace colours and scales passed to TraceGeometry and draw_trace_figure().

classes.name: TraceUniforms
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Plain uniform-block value type produced by TraceGeometry::draws() and copied into a GPU buffer.

classes.name: TraceMarkers
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Event, epoch and annotation markers of the trace view; drawn by viz::qt::ChannelRhiRenderer into its overlay texture and exercised by test_viz_trace_view.

classes.name: TraceSource
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Interface a trace host implements to feed TraceView; viz::qt::ChannelRhiRenderer adapts its channel model to it.

classes.name: TraceVertices
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Value type of interleaved trace vertices returned by TraceSource::vertices().

classes.name: TraceView
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Interaction state of the raw-data trace view; driven by viz::qt::ChannelRhiRenderer and exercised by test_viz_trace_view, it has no standalone use without a trace host.

classes.name: ViewAnimator
classes.exempt_reason: registry: Timestamp-driven scroll and zoom animations of a TraceView; ticked by viz::qt::ChannelRhiRenderer and exercised by test_viz_trace_view.
